title: Luke — continuous phase-four reproduction pass
status_note: This is an executable-direction contract, not a completed render. The source clip is present in Dropbox; the 3D reconstruction and final render remain unverified.

source.rule: Inspect the actual footage before setting timing, camera, pose, or body measurements. Do not substitute a generic character or invented movement.

preserve: hair, beard, expression, and established visual identity
original performance, pose language, and continuity wherever the source permits

transformation.growth_profile: smooth progressive increase, then settle and hold
priority: torso thickness with coherent waist and abdomen
hands, feet, joints, and stance scaled coherently
transformation.proportionality: All body regions must deform together. Do not shorten limbs, compress the torso, or create isolated inflated muscle shapes.
transformation.user_direction: Keep the phase-four scale. Magnify at that stage without over-fattening or escalating into phase six. Preserve the preferred chest fullness while maintaining coherent proportions.

surface_and_wardrobe.skin: high-detail realistic skin with natural pore scale, subtle subsurface response, and coherent light falloff
surface_and_wardrobe.anatomy: rounded connected muscle forms; no triangular faceting, disconnected spheres, or paper-cutout silhouettes
surface_and_wardrobe.clothing: retain the source wardrobe where possible; cloth must stretch, wrinkle, compress, and remain attached through deformation

animation.final_hold: Allow the phase-four result to settle and remain visible; do not immediately cut away.

camera_and_environment.camera: derive framing, angle, distance, and movement from the source clip; use low-angle emphasis only where supported by the reference
camera_and_environment.continuity: camera motion must remain temporally smooth and preserve subject readability
camera_and_environment.environment: retain source environment as the spatial scale reference unless a deliberate reconstruction is required
camera_and_environment.lighting: match source direction and softness before adding stylization

audio.mixing: retain useful original ambience and performance sounds; add music or designed sound only as a separate synchronized layer

pipeline: inspect source video and extract representative frames
record source duration, frame rate, framing, pose, and camera movement
establish identity-locked character geometry and a deformable skeletal rig
fit baseline proportions to the source
validate silhouette and identity at intermediate frames
compare diagnostic frames against the source
preserve source audio and mix synchronized sound
review the exported video and save the verified master to Dropbox
acceptance_tests: face and identity remain recognizable throughout
growth is continuous with no size jumps between frames
phase four is the maximum and remains stable at the end
height and limb length increase alongside mass
chest fullness is retained without disproportionate fattening
skin, cloth, joints, and contact remain coherent
camera and source performance remain temporally aligned
the final export is opened and visually checked before being called complete
next_action: Transfer the Dropbox source into the render workspace, inspect it frame-by-frame, and establish the identity-locked baseline before building the rig.
